subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Phonics: identifies the 'n' sound at the beginning of words

show.line: Listen. n as in nose. n, n, nose. My friend Nandi has a nose and a neck!

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with n, as in nose?
Say the sound with me. n, as in nose!

rounds.story: Nandi and Neo are friends. They share a naartjie at break. What do they share?

rounds.prompt: Which body part starts with n? n, n.
What is this? It starts with n.
Does it start with n? Put n words in the n group.

hints: Listen for n at the start. n, n, nose.
Put your tongue up and hum. nnn.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with n.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Ball starts with b. Nose starts with n.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. n, n, nose. Nose starts with n!

parent_line: Can hear the n sound at the start of words.
